90e48190d7f5.title: Google Cloud services largely restored in UK; Revolut services back up in Singapore
90e48190d7f5.snippet: A power outage at a Google Cloud data centre near London disrupted several UK banks and Revolut services, including in Singapore.

856e65a58d72.title: Singapore launches S$143 million initiative to help industries cut emissions
856e65a58d72.snippet: Three companies have also been approved to import and supply biomethane, a renewable alternative to natural gas, as Singapore explores ways to help industries decarbonise.
